name: Torque-Balance Citadel
core_rationale: Central planetary-carrier hub town of Differential Spur Gorge at [1, 1] where differential machinists equalize counter-rotating bevel shafts above the Epicyclic Pinion Vault.

terrain_tile.water_feature: Counter-weighted copper oil-damping rings surrounding the central differential carrier plaza

North.lock_message: Counter-rotating sun-gear teeth across Sun-Gear Escarpment shear unshielded gliders; Carrier-Warden Bram requires the Epicyclic Carrier Pin before locking the northern gear-bridge.

resident_npcs.name: Carrier-Warden Bram
resident_npcs.dialogue_greeting: Welcome to Torque-Balance Citadel! While the outer bevel rings spin in opposite directions, our central plaza stays rock-steady around my 0.58 meter torque desk.

resident_npcs.name: Pinion-Wright Talia
resident_npcs.dialogue_greeting: Down in the Epicyclic Pinion Vault, a sun-pinion juggernaut guards the Epicyclic Carrier Pin needed to cross Sun-Gear Escarpment!

causal_continuity.evidence: Anchors Differential Spur Gorge at [1, 1] directly above Krono's Epicyclic Pinion Vault.

fantasy_and_wonder.evidence: Stationary brass carrier citadel ringed by counter-rotating planetary bevel rings.

character_scale_consistency.evidence: 0.58 to 0.60m torque desks, 0.14m brass cog-risers, 2.20m x 1.65m doorways, and 13.0m plazas for 1.05m characters.

spatial_and_ecological_consistency.evidence: Safe town hub (0 resident_spawns) at [1, 1] with symmetric West, Dungeon, and North (fog_of_lore) portals.

intentional_mystery_discipline.evidence: Guards the northern Sun-Gear Escarpment behind a Fog of Lore portal with explicit lock_message.
